# GHX + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-10-22 | Duration: 24.549999237060547m

## Summary
GHX has used self-hosted GrowthBook for nearly one and a half years across eight to nine applications, including two production applications, with Node.js and C Sharp SDKs integrated into mobile, web, and API services. The team wants to expand beyond feature flags into A/B testing, AI testing, client-specific enablement, and deployment controls. Key requirements include live mobile flag updates without redeployment, product-level access controls, Prometheus and APM connections, analytics dashboards, custom fields, and client grouping. Self-hosting remains important because GHX is a healthcare company that wants control over its data. Christian proposed a two-week Enterprise trial, which Nilesh accepted through GrowthBook Cloud for evaluation. The proof of concept will test experimentation, client grouping, access controls, and mobile behavior. Self-hosted Enterprise pricing was presented as $175,000 annually, $1,250 per user annually, or $500 per experiment in addition to the platform fee. Leadership approval and pricing review remain necessary.

## Keywords
GrowthBook Enterprise, Self-hosted deployment, Feature flags, A/B testing, Mobile SDKs, Experiment-based pricing

## Action Items
**Christian Liebenow**
Provision GrowthBook Enterprise trial (09:00)
Send trial details and pricing proposal (21:26)

**Nilesh**
Present Enterprise trial (11:56)
Review experiment-based pricing model (15:04)
